answer: A Dedicated device bound by attestation certificate with one identity per channel ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. Auditors look for the karst that does not belong: a channel with no owner behind it. From the juniper to the cedar, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
